description: Database for Structural Control and Monitoring Benchmark Problems is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ekin Gultepe, University of Canterbury (canterbury.ac.nz). Tremendous progress has been made over the last two decades toward making structural monitoring and control a viable technology for enhancing structural functionality and safety against natural hazards such as strong earthquakes and high winds. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 39 top-level files (CSV, PDF, PNG, JPG, AVI). Its DOI is 10.4231/d3q52fc7t. Keywords: databases , structural monitoring , structural control , earthquake engineering . Published 2013-03-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
